items.information: Popping Off Pukekohe A 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. Please check the event list and timings to see which day you would like to register for as there will be different events on different days ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdHdTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8ca83de1b84ca1adb1aaa2f8fcd91f0e5d2516dd/PukekoheAWhiteBG.png)

This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, January 2nd is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, January 12th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.information: GuateMaya Open 2021 será el evento que marcará el retorno de las competencias oficiales al país. Con protocolos de Bioseguridad de las Autoridades Locales y los establecidos por la WCA, GuateMaya busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en Guatemala de la forma mas segura posible para todos nuestros competidores y asistentes. - Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. - El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. - Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años With GuateMaya 2021 we hope to return to hold official competitions regularly in the country. Using Covid-19 protocols from the local authorities and those sugested by the WCA, GuateMaya 2021 looks forward to improving the local development of the speedcubing in Guatemala, guaranteeing the safety of the competitors and staff. -Temperature will be measured at the entrance -Use of masks will be mandatory during all the competition -Vaccination proof will be required to enter to the venue

Pretendemos que todos los que puedan, vengan a competir, y disfruten de una nueva experiencia de competición, siempre respetando los protocolos vigentes, lo que lo convierte en un torneo único. Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar. Welcome to the Abierto de Navidad 2021, we are pleased to bring the tournaments back to Buenos Aires after such a long time, our event will feature 9 official WCA categories distributed in 12 rounds. Our goal is that everyone who can, comes to compete, and enjoy a new competition experience, always respecting the current protocols, which makes it a unique tournament. We request punctuality to all and recommend arriving at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor is going to participate.

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue. In the event of cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. venue.details: In the gym, with additional space in the nearby foyer and library space as well

items.information: **As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), all competitors and their (single) guest must provide proof of having received at least one dose of vaccination in order to enter the venue. As such, please do not register unless you will have had at least one dose of a vaccine before the competition date, as otherwise you will not be allowed to enter the venue nor compete. We will send registered competitors further details in an email when the government releases more details.** Cubing solo over the pandemic has made us only too glad to host an actual, face to face, long awaited gathering for local and perhaps not so local cubers...so welcome to BC Cubing Comeback 2021-either A or B! We the organizers of [Fraser Valley Open 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpring2018) and [2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpringOpen2019) are thrilled to invite you this time to the heart of Coquitlam for a fun and safe return to cubing, competing and most of all connecting together! Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Note that this is a **one of a pair of twin competitions**. We have not had twin competitions in BC before. Please see the [Twin Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16216-twin-competitions) for more information. A small portion of each registration fee will be in support of the BC Fires Appeal with the Canadian Red Cross. Each dollar we donate will be matched by both the provincial and federal governments. Donations will be used for immediate and ongoing relief efforts as well as for long-term recovery and preparedness. Feel free to check out [the Red Cross page](https://www.redcross.ca/how-we-help/current-emergency-responses/2021-british-columbia-fires) for more information. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16211-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11vtCfK4waavNE_PUpHGQ12mZxPuTA6_Hrbd79cNUhd0/edit?usp=sharing). Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free. Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers stay well within WCA recommendations. **If you're not a competitor, or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in with the additional ask that all attendees show 1) a negative test prior to venue entry or 2) that they have been fully vaccinated for 2 weeks prior. The WCA reserves the right in the event of a clear 4th wave in BC to cancel the competition outright. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes. Es importante recordar que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás (artículo [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3) del reglamento). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (categoría, no competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar con el organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors if possible. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue. So, please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Important!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: Välkommen till de första tävlingarna att arrangeras i tvillingformat i Sverige! Denna tävling hör ihop med [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), och det är endast tillåtet att anmäla sig och tävla i en av dessa två tävlingar. Mer information om detta finns under fliken [Tvillingtävling](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition). Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19), med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs [hemsida](https://svekub.se/). Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter. ----- Welcome to the first ever twin competitions in Sweden! This competition is twinned with [Flen - Stora Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16202-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021#16171-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub [website](https://svekub.se/). Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 é o 11º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 is the 11th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: Español: La competencia Montevideo Palace 2019 será la tercera edición que se llevará acabo en este local. Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. Ésta competencia esta abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción. Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1). English: The Montevideo Palace 2019 competition will be the third edition that will take place in this venue. Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality. Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration. Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulation. Please also take into account articles [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) and [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

items.name: Tirol Open 2019
items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte. Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition. **Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.** **DINNERS**: On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue. Saturday evening for 10€: * "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us) * A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake Sunday evening for 15€: * A big pizza (to be chosen on the day) * A dessert, like on Saturday **LASER GAME**: On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: **Português** O KubeKids é o 10º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** KubeKids is the 10th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information: Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя. На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем). Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15. За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали! Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain. Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided) The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15. For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.name: Battle for Toledo 2019
items.information: Every competitor MUST declare their allegiance to either Ohio State or Michigan. Please write in the comments if you would like to represent Ohio State or Michigan. If you do not pick a team, we will notify you via email until you pick one. This event will feature a crew battle between five members of each team. The members will be selected semi-randomly based on the results of 3x3 R1. The crew battle will consist of a best 2-out-of-3, head-to-head competition. Event 1 is a mystery event. Event 2 is a 3x3 head-to-head relay. The tiebracker event is a mystery event. The winning team will receive the $100 prize pot ($20/player) paid entirely in $2 bills.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. **ENGLISH** This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. REGISTRATION: A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section). Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab. It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID. *Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method. Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980. El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**

items.information: SNZ Zouthern 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration. **ATTENTION!!! 1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.
